title: Process Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

The impact you’ll make

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries. Your role involves developing new and advanced process formulations, defining equipment hardware to meet processing requirements, evaluating test data, and coordinating design requirements to ensure compatibility of processing methods. Your expertise and knowledge play a crucial role our customers success, making an impact on the next generation of semiconductor breakthroughs.

In this role, you will directly contribute to ___.

What you’ll do

  • Conduct process engineering research, development, and evaluation in support of Lam’s cutting-edge semiconductor equipment and systems.
  • Review and enhance processing techniques and methods applied in the manufacture and fabrication of products.
  • Develop and sustain new processes and process improvements to reduce production costs and increase yields.
  • Compile and analyze test data to establish next steps in process development and determine appropriate limits and variables for process specifications.
  • Collaborate internally to plan, collect data, analyze results, and report on customer demos for existing process applications.
  • Contribute to next generation product development and release activities supporting the semiconductor roadmap.
  • Provide leadership, clear direction, and guidance to process technicians to support execution activities.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 3+ years of experience; or a Ph D with min an year of professional experience; or equivalent experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with working in a laboratory and on semiconductor equipment with experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.
  • In-depth understanding of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and/or Design of Experiments (DOE).
  • Highly proficient in MATLAB, Python, or other similar scientific computing language.
  • Working knowledge of statistical analysis and problem-solving methodologies.
  • Experience with statistical tools (JMP, Minitab, etc.)
  • Background in Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD), Chemical Vapor Deposition (CVD), Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD), or Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD).
  • Background in Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).
  • Knowledge of Material synthesis and material characterization.
  • Experience working in a collaborative and matrixed environment with diverse teams, semiconductor customers, and/or partners.

Our commitment

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

title: Electrical Program Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of:

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's WETS products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry

Primary RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Executes Electrical Engineering technical assignments, projects with primary focus on designing, developing, modifying Power distribution and Control Panels.

  • Provides corrective solutions for Problem Reports of varying complexities on power boxes from suppliers and customers.
  • Provides immediate response and timely resolution to design related production issues encountered during the product build process.
  • Works in a very dynamic and fast paced work environment by providing custom design solutions for non-standard customer requirements having frequent design updates.
  • Conducts gating design reviews to get alignment on design package from cross functional leaders.
  • Experience in setting up equipment for experimentation / testing in laboratory environment, setting up safe practices.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Proven hands-on experience on power boxes & control boxes in gathering requirements, designing, testing and implementing to high volume manufacturing.
  • Proficiency in assessing loading, performing SCCR calculations, thermal calculations, wire sizing, busbar designs, switchgear selection, etc. for power boxes and panels
  • Proficiency in handling multiple configurations, logic for EMO, LOTO Concept, multiple power inputs and outputs.
  • Hands on experience in creation of electrical schematic diagram, control panel facility connections & field disconnects.
  • Must have worked on electrical engineering CAD tools like E3 ZUKEN or equivalent CAD packages for circuit design & simulation, form board flattening for EE documentation.
  • Experience with executing & reviewing FMEA, structured Investigation, Problem Solving & Decision Making.
  • Good understanding of different standards and compliances like – NEC, NFPA 79, UL 508A, IEC standard
  • Proven leadership & mentoring skills.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s in Electrical Engineering with 10 years of relevant experience or
  • Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering 12 years of relevant experience

Desirable Skills:

  • Being well versed with Part life cycle management, Obsolescence management activities.
  • SEMI Standards knowledge - S2, S8, S22 etc.
  • Exposure to DFX for Power Boxes/panels
  • Basic Knowledge for electronic circuits, PCBs is a value addition.
  • Controls and logics (IO controls) – Design & development and troubleshooting
  • Communication protocols knowledge and troubleshooting with software interfaces

title: Electrical Technical Lead Engineer
jobDescription:
The Group You'll Be A Part Of

WETS Deposition group at Lam India Global Hardware Technology (LIGHT) is hiring a Electrical Lead Engineer for its product development engineering and product ownership team.

Job Summary

As an Electrical Lead Engineer, you will lead the design and delivery of electrical and electro‑mechanical subsystems for wafer fabrication equipment, with a primary focus on fluid delivery systems and process modules for WETS Deposition products. The role provides technical leadership across system architecture, electrical integration, and cross‑functional collaboration to deliver robust, manufacturable, and serviceable solutions.

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop Functional Requirement Specifications for various Electro-Mechanical systems.
  • Selection of Electrical & Electronics OEM components and materials for Power distribution, I/O Controllers, Sensors, Cables, PCBs etc.
  • Create and Release system level Electrical engineering drawings & bill of materials using Engineering Change Management process.
  • Work on Electrical/Electronic engineering CAD tools for circuit design & simulations.
  • Perform various circuit analyses like De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc.
  • Define project schedule, work breakdown structure and milestones to drive concept to production lifecycle.
  • Study and recommend corrective/ permanent solutions for technical challenges/new products.
  • Define test procedures, and participate in assembly, build and test verification
  • Well versed with Part life cycle management, Obsolescence management activities.
  • Conduct and drive Design reviews to get buy-in from all cross functional teams.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • EDUCATION: B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Electrical Engineering
  • Experience: Bachelors in Electrical/Electronics Engineering with a minimum 8 exp. or Masters in Electrical Engineering with a minimum 6 Yrs Exp.

Core Competencies

  • Proficient in system level understanding of Electro-Mechanical Sub-systems (Semi-conductor/Automotive/Aerospace), Power Distribution/Control systems and/or Industrial Automation.
  • Proficient in Electrical/Electronic Circuit concept design & development with safety interlocks & various circuit analyses. (Circuit analyses include De-rating & Stress analysis, Power analysis & Logic compatibility analysis etc.)
  • Proficient in selecting Electrical/Electronic OEM components.
  • Expert level knowledge of Engineering change management & problem-solving skills
  • Must have worked on any one of electrical engineering CAD tools like PCAD, ORCAD, ZUKEN, Cadence or equivalent CAD packages for circuit design & simulation.
  • Familiar with standards like - UL 508, IEC 60947, SEMI S22, NFPA79.

Desirable Competencies

  • Experience in Semiconductor Wafer Fab Equipment (WFE) domain.
  • Experience in capital equipment or similar (for e.g., Semiconductor, Process industries, medical instrumentation, Automotive, Aerospace, etc.) industry in a sub-system / module design project.
  • Experience in setting up equipment for experimentation / testing in laboratory environment, setting up safe practices.
  • Good Communication skills and able to mentor junior engineers.

As a Mechanical Lead Engineer, you will own the design and delivery of advanced mechanical and electro-mechanical subsystems for wafer fabrication equipment, with primary focus on fluid delivery systems and Process modules for WETS Deposition products. You will provide technical leadership across system architecture, packaging, and cross-functional integration to deliver robust, manufacturable, and serviceable solutions.

title: Mechanical Engineer 4
jobDescription:
The group you’ll be a part of

Etch Engineering India, Lam Research

The impact you’ll make

As a Mechanical Engineer at Lam, you're designing and defining cutting-edge mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. Your role involves feasibility studies, testing, and guiding teams in detailed design and fabrication. You provide the crucial design information needed to shape our technology's packaging.

In this role, you will directly contribute to the design and development of sub-systems and assemblies used in Semi-conductor machines.

What you’ll do

  • Lead medium to high complex sub-system related projects with full ownership through product life cycle of mechanical and electro-mechanical systems from concept to productization including, designing, CAD modeling, development, and testing / validation.
  • Lead design reviews, project reviews and participate in technical discussions. Mentor team for successfully completing design reviews and action items.
  • Collaboration with cross functional teams to develop robust design solutions that ensure functionality, safety, manufacturability, serviceability, cost advantage, etc.
  • Continually work towards expanding ownership on adjacent modules by acquiring new capabilities.
  • Ensure documentation and alignment with SEMI, Lam standards, and industry best practices for geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T). Provide support to engineering and field service teams for capital equipment at the Lam labs, factory and in the field.
  • Handle customer escalations, field problems including troubleshooting, containment actions, failure analysis report & corrective actions.
  • Conduct detailed analysis including material selection, structural, dynamic, and thermal, and manufacturability assessment.
  • Develop, conduct and mentor feasibility studies and test plans to characterize and validate design performance.
  • Create and edit procedures for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting and maintenance recommendation guide.
  • Being accountable for delivering on time with quality as part of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and obtaining necessary approval from stakeholders by following Product Development and Release (PDR) process.
  • Responsible to lead a team of Engineers to drive engineering excellence, optimize and implement solutions for projects as part of trouble shooting at customer or supplier end, continuous improvement programs (CIP), cost reduction, reliability improvement and RCCAs.
  • Support staffing, training, mentoring & coaching, and strategic planning to build capacity and capability.

Who we’re looking for

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering with 12+ years of experience; or an advanced degree with 10+ years of previous professional experience
  • Excellent leadership skills in team planning, strategizing, innovation
  • Proficient in managing deliverables of interdisciplinary engineering team for tasks, projects, or program and to drive engineering excellence in Volume manufacturing phase
  • Decision making experience to solve problems related to Engineering and Business processes in collaboration with cross functional team in a matrixed organization
  • Proficient in concept design and development of complex components/medium-complex sub-systems by following PDR process – generating engineering requirement specification, conducting design reviews, performing DFMEA, validating designs through prototyping and testing and releasing engineering documentation
  • Demonstrated Problem Solving and Decision-Making ability by applying structured processes & tools such as 8D, Fishbone, 5 Whys, Pugh matrix & Pareto chart
  • Experience in driving and managing projects in collaboration with CFT (Manufacturing, Supply chain, Electrical/controls engineering and Product safety) for project deliverables
  • Expertise in Design for Manufacturability, Assembly, Serviceability, Cost principles, and Engineering Change Management
  • Strong Product Development and Design experience in Mechanical domain
  • Proficient in 3D CAD tools such as Solid Edge or CREO or Siemens NX
  • Hands-on experimental and design background coupled with solid engineering skills
  • Knowledge of machining, welding, molding, sheet-metal fabrication & casting processes
  • Ability to work well in a team, in a fast-paced matrixed environment with aggressive deadlines and multiple priorities
  • Excellent communication, both written and verbal, and technical presentation skills

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in Semiconductor Wafer Fab Equipment (WFE) domain
  • Experience in Sheetmetal design and manufacturing processes
  • Exposure to design of Fluidics and Pneumatics systems and selection of OEM components like Fluid system fittings, Valves, Transducers, Pressure Regulators, Sensors, Gauges, etc.
  • Knowledge in Engineering Change Management Process, SAP, PLM, TCE, Project Management tools (MS Project), exposure to Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VAVE) concepts
  • Proficiency in Thermal hand calculations and basic simulations (Conduction, Convection, Heat dissipation and increase in temperature) to facilitate selection of heat sinks, Cooling systems like Fans etc.
  • Knowledge and exposure to ANSI, ASME, SAE, ISO, SEMI standards applicable to semiconductor industry

The AI Hub within Global Information Systems (GIS) is a centralized, high-impact group responsible for developing, scaling, and evangelizing AI capabilities across Lam Research. Build and maintain the integration “plumbing” — connectors to enterprise applications, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, APIs, and data services that link the AI platform to Lam's business systems.

Extend and operationalize enterprise productivity tools — making Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio more capable and widely adopted across the larger user community through custom connectors, agents, and plugins.

Partner with product managers, AI governance, and the full-stack team to translate business problems into production-grade AI solutions.

Establish engineering best practices for quality, security, observability, and cost-efficiency across the team's deliverables.

Collaborate across US and India teams to ensure a cohesive, follow-the-sun delivery model.

As a Process Engineer at Lam, you will operate on cutting-edge technology, harnessing atomic precision, material science, and surface engineering to push technical boundaries.   • Master’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or Physics or related field with 12+ years of experience; or a Ph D with 10+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.

  • Leadership responsibilities

    • Responsible for managing multiple customer accounts in driving Lam Etch Tool Strategy, enabling successful tool evaluations at the customer site & driving new business opportunities.

    • Responsible for creating & presenting technical review material for key technical projects on frequent basis for high level TRMs at customer site.
    • Will be subject matter expert & key technologist with etch experience in process development in advanced technology nodes, will be responsible in coming up with solutions & implementing learnings from global scientific community in new approaches for some of grand etch challenges.
    • Works with cross-functional teams to get information and results as needed to enable successful tool demo and business wins/defenses.

    Customer Relation

    • Professionally represent the company to the customer. Utilize knowledge of company’s product lines and services to keep existing/ potential customers informed when new/ additional needs are identified.

    • Comfortable with travelling 40-50% of the time during initial training.
    • Comfortable with travelling 10-20% of the time after training for on-site customer support.

  • In depth understanding of Plasma Physics, Reactive Ion Etching (RIE), Atomic Layer Etching (ALE), Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP), Capacitively Coupled Plasma (CCP).

  • Experience in surface preparation and analytical techniques.

As an Electrical Program Lead Engineer, you will serve as the system‑level technical authority for electrical and controls architecture of wafer fabrication equipment who could handle complex problems. This role owns end‑to‑end electrical, controls, and system engineering responsibility for assigned tool sub‑modules and platforms, defining architecture, interfaces, Theory of Operation, and integration strategy from concept through high‑volume manufacturing and field support.

  • Owns quality issues from the subsystems designed

  • Capable of driving group level innovation programs/ technical roadmaps / KSA gaps

  • Act as system engineer and owner for assigned electrical sub modules, also translate system-level requirements into executable
